string.text: Hold a key over an inventory cell to transfer, drop, disassemble, or strip. A stacked cell does the whole stack. In the stack popup, each hovered row is one item. Moving to a new cell acts on that item. Inventory sort will not chain into whatever slides under the cursor.

Hold to transfer the item under the cursor (loot and trade). A stacked cell transfers the whole stack. In the stack popup, each hovered row transfers that item. Replaces GAMMA Fast Transfer. Default Left Shift.

Hold to disassemble the item under the cursor. A stacked cell disassembles the whole stack. In the stack popup, each hovered row is one item. Equipped items and items that cannot be disassembled are skipped. Only while inventory or loot is open.
Grant unread stash coords when disassembling PDAs. Double tool wear if a coord is found, triple if the PDA was encrypted. Shows a lock icon on encrypted PDAs.
When GAMMA wants a tool type, wear the lowest-condition stack of that type that will still survive (including drag-and-drop). Does not change which tool type is required.
Scrap detached scopes, silencers, launchers, and tac kits into craft parts.
After disassemble, post the parts you get on the PDA ticker. Off by default.

Hold to drop the item under the cursor. A stacked cell drops the whole stack. In the stack popup, each hovered row is one item. Equipped and quest items are skipped. Only while inventory or loot is open.

Hold to strip the weapon under the cursor. A stacked cell strips every weapon in that stack. In the stack popup, each hovered row is one weapon. Non-weapons are skipped. Stripped parts stay with the weapon. Equipped items cannot be moved onto companions.
If you disassemble a weapon that still has attachments or parts (keybind, drag a tool, or context menu), strip those first instead. Once nothing is left to strip, disassemble works normally.
